searchText: Is it safe to assume type 0 is reserved and won’t be used? In an API, can I let type 0 refer to “use legacy transaction serialization”? (For when a person explicitly wants to use old-school transactions) If so, can we get that added somehow? I think <@301186049323958275> suggested a registry or something at some point where reserved totes could be added. 0x19 should be added too, to prevent EIP-191 conflicts. I don't recommend making that assumption. `undefined` seems to make more sense to me for legacy transactions. If you really wanted a sentinel value you could use one of the leading bytes legacy transactions uses, which are guaranteed to not be used by other transaction formats in the foreseeable future. Ok. The problem is I want to use undefined for “use the network default” type. I may make -1 force legacy then. Stylistically, I would use a string union for TS/JS rather than numbered types. Numbers are for computers, strings are for humans. I don’t want people to have to explicitly specify 2 to make sane choices. Then when type 3 comes along, all that pls code needs to be updated just to make things work. `'default' | 'legacy' | '1559'` Yeah. I was thinking that, but the “EIP-2930” and “EIP-1559” fall out of order. 🙂 String unions aren't ordered? I mean, as a developer, new to Ethereum, it is not obvious the string “1559” is a newer standard than “2930”. If you were looking at the docs trying to pick the latest standard. If you don't know what they mean, you should use `default`. There is no ideal solution, is all I mean. There is also a need to maintain some backwards compatibility. But I won’t use 0. And will mull on strings. Maybe strings for v6 in a few months. 🙂 Also, you very much should not assume transaction types are "ordered" and one is better than another. It just so happens to bet he case with 1559, but that isn't expected to be the norm. The word “default” also get confusing in JavaScript. 😉 Transaction type 4 may be "CancelationTransaction" for example. Yeah. `'legacy' | '1559' | 'ricmoo decides'` Lol! “leap-of-faith” Thanks. 🙂
